chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: Pérez Prado's Patricia and the unsuit
summary: He says Pérez Prado took the first part of Perdido for his hit Patricia; Tempo wanted him to sue but he let it go because Prado had copied others.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: It seems I remember your telling me that, or else Duke told me, that you sued Perez Parado for his tune, 'Patricia'?
Perez Parado, when he had a hit with 'Patricia' -- remember?
Oh, he stole that from me, yeah.
I remember your saying it was just Perdito again. Didn't you sue him?
No. They asked me why I don't sue him, but he had been stealing numbers from everybody, so then he was allowed later on, to sue me, so I said, oh, well,
" forget it." But Temple wanted me to sue him.
I guess I remember you and Duke talking about it.
Yeah, yeah; they wanted me to sue him, because he really stole the first part of the tune -- da da, da da, da da -- that's the way he wrote it, but that's "Caravan."
